'''Tony Ramirez''' is a mechanic by day and the [[Southside Saints]]' getaway driver by night.

== Background ==
Born and raised on the south side, Tony learned to drive in his uncle's tow truck.

== Personality ==
Loud, loyal and impossible to stay mad at.

== Notable events ==
* Drove the getaway car in the [[Harbor Bank Heist]].
